name: Simple QR Code Generator
tagline: - Simple QR Code Generator is a powerful, privacy-first tool that lets you create, customise, scan, and share QR codes directly in your browser
description: - Simple QR Code Generator is a powerful, privacy-first tool that lets you create, customise, scan, and share QR codes directly in your browser. - It supports a wide range of data types including URLs, text, WiFi credentials, contact cards, emails, and more, making it ideal for both personal and professional use. - With advanced customisation options like multiple dot styles, colour gradients, logo uploads, and frame designs, you can create visually unique QR codes that match your brand or style
